description: Actor reference fails to dispatch response messages back to caller mailbox on ask requests, deadlocking callers.
spec_notes: ActorRef.process_one must enqueue replies to the sender mailbox via registry lookup.

repo_files.message.py:
"""Actor message envelope."""

from dataclasses import dataclass
from typing import Any, Optional


@dataclass
class ActorMessage:
    sender: Optional[str]
    target: str
    payload: Any
    is_ask: bool = False
    correlation_id: Optional[str] = None

tests.test_actor_mailbox.py:
from actor_ref import ActorRef
from message import ActorMessage


def test_basic_tell_delivery():
    a1 = ActorRef("sender", lambda m: None)
    a2 = ActorRef("receiver", lambda m: None)
    a1.tell(a2, "hello")
    msg = a2.mailbox.dequeue()
    assert msg is not None
    assert msg.payload == "hello"


def test_empty_mailbox_returns_false():
    a = ActorRef("idle", lambda m: None)
    assert a.process_one() is False


def test_actor_ask_response_routing():
    a1 = ActorRef("worker", lambda m: f"processed_{m.payload}")
    a2 = ActorRef("caller", lambda m: None)
    a1.system_registry = {"caller": a2, "worker": a1}
    a2.system_registry = {"caller": a2, "worker": a1}

    # Caller sends ask message to worker
    ask_msg = ActorMessage(sender="caller", target="worker", payload="task_1", is_ask=True, correlation_id="req_100")
    a1.mailbox.enqueue(ask_msg)
    # Worker processes message
    a1.process_one()
    # Reply must be queued into caller mailbox with priority correlation_id!
    reply = a2.mailbox.dequeue()
    assert reply is not None
    assert reply.correlation_id == "req_100"
    assert reply.payload == "processed_task_1"
